نعلولي (form XII)
# نَعْلَوْلِي (naʕlawlī) /naʕ.law.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# نَعْلَوْلِيَ (naʕlawliya) /naʕ.law.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
